metadata.description: Economic theme taxonomy mapping underlying issuers to non-additive macro and supply-chain risk factors.
metadata.non_additive_note: Theme exposures are non-additive across themes because a single issuer (e.g. NVDA, MSFT) can belong to multiple economic themes simultaneously.

AI_DATA_CENTER_AND_POWER_CAPEX.name: AI Data Centre Compute & Power Infrastructure
AI_DATA_CENTER_AND_POWER_CAPEX.description: Issuers directly exposed to hyperscale AI data centre capital expenditure, GPU/ASIC accelerators, semiconductor fabrication tools, and baseload data-centre power generation.

NVDA.note: Data Center segment accounts for >85% of revenue via Hopper/Blackwell AI GPU clusters.

MSFT.note: Largest global AI cloud capex spender (Azure AI infrastructure and OpenAI partnership).

VST.note: Independent power producer providing baseload nuclear and natural gas generation for hyperscale AI data centres.

TSM.note: Primary global foundry fabricating CoWoS and advanced 3nm/5nm AI accelerator silicon.

AVGO.note: Custom AI XPUs and high-speed Ethernet switching silicon for hyperscale AI clusters.

ASML.note: Sole supplier of EUV lithography systems required for leading-edge AI logic and DRAM nodes.

AMAT.note: Wafer fabrication equipment for gate-all-around (GAA) logic and high-bandwidth memory (HBM) packaging.

MU.note: High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM3E) supplier integrated into AI training and inference GPUs.

LRCX.note: Etch and deposition equipment critical for advanced 3D packaging and HBM through-silicon vias.

AMD.note: Instinct MI300X AI accelerators and EPYC server CPUs deployed in hyperscale data centres.

ARM.note: Neoverse CPU architecture licensing for custom hyperscaler data centre processors.

KLAC.note: Process control and wafer inspection systems for advanced node AI semiconductor manufacturing.

AMZN.note: AWS hyperscale cloud capex and custom Trainium/Inferentia AI silicon infrastructure.

GOOGL.note: Google Cloud AI infrastructure and custom TPU v5/v6 data centre clusters.

META.note: Multi-billion dollar AI training cluster capex for Llama models and recommendation engines.

ORCL.note: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) GPU superclusters leased to AI model developers.
